crossRefs.note: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and ate from the tree, about which I commanded you…
You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he…

translations.web: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
translations.bsb: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
translations.kjv: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
translations.asv: But man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.
